integrity: The classification is proved symbolically from the chain-ring valuation model. A standalone finite stress test verifies the degree and reconstruction formulas across hundreds of length multisets; the computation is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for finite commutative principal ideal rings and the simple annihilator-compressed graph.
Residue-field cardinalities are not determined by this graph.
The 2016 broad compressed-graph paper was not available as a fully inspected publisher manuscript in this review.
title: The simple annihilator-compressed graph determines chain lengths of finite principal ideal rings, except for one \(K_2\) ambiguity
